perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.desc: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Compulsive Reloader
perks.desc: Grants increased reload speed when close to full magazine.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.desc: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

perks.name: Slickdraw
perks.desc: Significantly increases handling, significantly decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Lead from Gold
perks.desc: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

perks.name: Heal Clip
perks.desc: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

perks.name: Cornered
perks.desc: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Controlled Burst
perks.desc: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for a short duration.

perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.desc:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Reservoir Burst
perks.desc: When the battery is full, your next burst deals additional damage and causes enemies to explode on death.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "The Eremite is an interesting fusion. If you didn't farm out an Envious Assassin / Controlled Burst Loaded Question from last season you can get a solar version this season. You can even craft it to your liking. If you prefer Golden Tricorn for a higher damage ceiling or Reservoir Burst for clearing out rooms of enemies. The possibilities are truly yours to harness. Lead from Gold and Heal Clip can be really nice additions too depending on your full loadout." Recommended MW: Charge Time.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "I'm sure most people have seen u/Legoleflash's new video on the Eremite (if you haven't, go watch it https://youtu.be/csuxec3lFcs). Essentially the main point is enhanced Slickdraw doesn't feel terrible and allows you to full send into range. With Slickdraw maxing out your handling you can even opt for handling reducing perks like Full Bore, or, better yet, Extended Barrel for a bump in recoil direction. If you don't like Slickdraw there you could opt for Offhand Strike and find a good balance of range and stability." Recommended MW: Range or Charge Time.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 76 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/4UoXFYD3DbunDEKIGDiriX?si=1957400d9e024ed5) with @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE pick for burst damage against Major Spec enemies and sustained damage against Boss Spec enemies in end-game content. Shapeable. The Eremite (named after a religious recluse, being the root for the word hermit), is a bit of a season 21 banger! Although the stats are below average, this should be on your list of weapons you aim to farm and craft. Fluted Barrel as the barrel perk bumps up handling and adds a dash of stability, but then go all in to battery size with ionized Battery. Enhanced Envious Assassin as the first trait column support perk bypasses the poor reload speed and can cram in up 18 shots somehow, after 15 rapid kills with other weapons, which means that you can go ham with Controlled Burst as the second column signature perk - 20% bonus damage and 10% quicker charge time, just for landing all your bolts. Alternatively in the same slot, Reservoir Burst can take your magazine size up to 20 and adds 25% damage to the first 15 shots. Either should be enough to chunk down champions or last a damage phase against a raid boss. Whether you find the Head Rush origin trait useful will depend on how often you crouch and get up again - if you do, the additional handling and reload speed is useful, if not game-changing. Recommended MW: Stability, with a damage-boosting (Boss or Taken Spec) or Backup Mag mod.

First-choice PvE pick for support builds in end-game content. Shapeable. The Eremite (named after a religious recluse, being the root for the word hermit), is a bit of a season 21 banger! Although the stats are below average, this should be on your list of weapons you aim to farm and craft. Fluted Barrel as the barrel perk bumps up handling and adds a dash of stability, and Enhanced Battery adds an additional shot. For support builds in end-game content, the new to season 21 Cure Clip as the support perk in the first trait slot, provides group healing on a reload after a kill - in the second, signature perk, trait slot Reservoir Burst adds 25% burst damage when the battery's full, adds the fun explosions, and needs a reload afterwards anyway to get it ready for next time, so works well as a combination. Whether you find the Head Rush origin trait useful will depend on how often you crouch and get up again - if you do, the additional handling and reload speed is useful, if not game-changing. Recommended MW: Reload Speed, with a damage-boosting (Major or Taken Spec) mod.

Range Masterwork. Taken from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=csuxec3lFcs "Slickdraw gives you 100 handling no matter what else you run on your weapon, plus a .95x animation duration multiplier, which is a scalar that takes you past what 100 handling can even do. The automatic 100 handling allows me to do WHATEVER I want to the detriment of handling, because it will ALWAYS be 100. So I can run Extended Barrel to bump my Recoil Direction to 85 and my range up 10, without any drawbacks of handling like I normally would... I suggest running this one of two different ways. Elemental Capacitor if you're on either void or stasis, and then Golden Tricorn if you run any other subclass." tags:god-pvp,pvp,controller,mnk
